files.prompt: Create one refined gallery-quality fine-art painting, horizontal 4:3 composition, without any border or frame. The concept is the intelligent digital connection between a modern steel construction site and a calm architectural office: on the left, elegant real steel structural beams and a small crane silhouette in mist; on the right, abstract smoked-glass architectural planes and the suggestion of a drafting desk; between them a graceful continuous network of very fine warm copper and teal luminous threads, like ideas and precise information flowing organically between people and places. Quiet innovative artificial intelligence expressed through subtle geometry and light, never robot heads, brains, circuit clipart or sci-fi dashboards. Sophisticated layered painterly realism and delicate architectural linework, soft ivory limestone, walnut browns, charcoal, restrained amber and muted teal highlights. Museum-worthy premium contemporary artwork, balanced negative space, beautiful atmospheric depth, tactile canvas detail, no people portraits, no advertising, no company identity. Absolutely NO text, words, letters, numbers, logos, names, symbols resembling writing, signatures or watermarks. It should feel natural hanging in a luxurious walnut and smoked-glass office.
